questions.question: 1. What is the value of 4! (4 factorial)?

explanations.c: Incorrect. 16 is not the value of 4!.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 12 is not the value of 4!

questions.question: 2. Which of the following best describes n! (n factorial)?

answers.a: The sum of all numbers from 1 to n
answers.b: The product of all numbers from 1 to n
answers.c: The product of all even numbers up to n
answers.d: The sum of all even numbers up to n

explanations.a: Incorrect. Factorial is a product, not a sum.
explanations.b: Correct. n! is the product of all positive integers from 1 to n.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Factorial includes all numbers, not just even ones.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Factorial is not a sum.

questions.question: 3. What is the value of 0! (zero factorial)?
4. Which of the following grows fastest as n increases?

explanations.a: Incorrect. n! grows much faster than n.
explanations.b: Incorrect. n! grows faster than n^2.
explanations.c: Correct. Factorial grows faster than any polynomial or exponential in n.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 2n is linear, n! is much faster.

questions.question: 5. What is the main reason why direct computation of large factorials is difficult on a computer?

answers.b: Factorials grow very quickly and exceed standard data types

explanations.b: Correct. Factorials grow rapidly and quickly exceed the storage capacity of standard data types.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Factorials are not always prime.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Computers can multiply, but factorials get too large.

questions.question: 6. Which formula can be used to find the number of digits in n! without computing n! directly?

explanations.a: Incorrect. n is not the number of digits in n!.
explanations.b: Incorrect. n^2 is not the number of digits in n!.
explanations.c: Correct. The number of digits in n! is floor(log10(n!)) + 1.
explanations.d: Incorrect. n! / 10 does not give the number of digits.

questions.question: 7. How do you count the number of trailing zeroes in n!?

answers.a: Count the number of times n is divisible by 2
answers.b: Count the number of times n is divisible by 5
answers.c: Count the number of pairs of 2 and 5 in the factorization of n!
answers.d: Count the number of digits in n!

explanations.a: Incorrect. There are more 2s than 5s in n!.
explanations.b: Incorrect. You need pairs of 2 and 5 to make a zero.
explanations.c: Correct. Each pair of 2 and 5 in n! produces a trailing zero.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Number of digits is unrelated to trailing zeroes.

questions.question: 8. Which of the following is the value of 5! ?

explanations.b: Incorrect. 60 is not the value of 5!.

questions.question: 9. Which of the following statements about factorials is false?

answers.b: n! is always even for n > 2
answers.c: n! is the product of all positive integers up to n
answers.d: n! is always a prime number

explanations.b: Correct. For n > 2, n! includes 2 as a factor, so it's even.
explanations.c: Correct. This is the definition of factorial.

questions.question: 10. In how many ways can 3 books be arranged on a shelf?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 3 books can be arranged in 3! = 6 ways.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 9 is not the number of arrangements.
explanations.d: Incorrect. 12 is not the number of arrangements.
